description: This file defines a static class 'Adam7' related to PNG image interlacing, including methods for calculating scanline counts, pixel positions, and interlacing pass details within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: Adam7
classes.description: A static class providing methods for PNG interlacing calculations based on the Adam7 algorithm.

methods.name: GetNumberOfScanlinesInPass
methods.description: Calculates the number of scanlines in a given interlacing pass based on image header dimensions.

methods.name: GetPixelsPerScanlineInPass
methods.description: Calculates the number of pixels per scanline for a specific pass.

methods.name: GetPixelIndexForScanlineInPass
methods.description: Determines the pixel coordinates (x, y) for a specific position within a pass and scanline.
